sloka: हिमवान् चैव विन्ध्यः च मेरुः च सुमहान् गिरिः ।भू तले संप्रकाशन्ते नागा इव जल आशये ॥४-६१-९॥
transliteration: himavān caiva vindhyaḥ ca meruḥ ca sumahān giriḥ ।bhū tale saṁprakāśante nāgā iva jala āśaye ॥4-61-9॥

translations.english: 'The mountains of the earth, Himavan and Vindhya and the great Meru looked like huge elephants in a huge pond.
